description: Maharashtra government's MARVEL will augment law enforcement by developing AI tools to provide tailor-made solutions to the police force.
body_lead: The Maharashtra Government launched MARVEL (Maharashtra Advanced Research and Vigilance for Enhanced Law Enforcement) in March 2024, marking India's first dedicated initiative to integrate artificial intelligence into law enforcement. MARVEL’s mission is to develop AI tools tailored to the specific needs of various police departments, enhancing crime prediction and expediting case resolutions.
